excerpt: WorkRamp, the learning platform for employee and customer training, was bought by Learning Pool in 2025 and is now sold by Confirm as Learn:Up and Academy.
content:
WorkRamp is a learning management system (LMS): software a company uses to train its employees, onboard new hires and run training academies for customers and partners. It was founded in 2015 in San Francisco and went through Y Combinator. Its customers have included Canva, Sprout Social, Reddit and Box, according to the acquisition announcement.

On 15 October 2025 Learning Pool, a learning technology company headquartered in Derry, Northern Ireland and owned by Marlin Equity Partners, announced it had acquired WorkRamp. WorkRamp's chief executive, Ted Blosser, wrote that it would continue as a core product within Learning Pool's portfolio. In August 2026 Learning Pool rebranded itself as Confirm and launched what it calls a Workforce Enablement System. WorkRamp's two products were renamed at the same time: the Employee Learning Cloud became Learn:Up and the Customer Learning Cloud became Academy. The old workramp.com address now redirects to the Learn:Up page on confirm.com.

Learn:Up covers courses, learning paths, guides, resource libraries, events and SCORM content, plus AI role-play simulations where an employee practises a conversation, such as a sales call, with an AI character and gets feedback. Academy is the customer-facing version for training a company's users or partners. Confirm's other products include Perform (performance reviews), Engage (formerly WorkStep) and Create (formerly Elucidat, a course authoring tool).

Confirm's pricing page lists Learn:Up from $9 (or GBP 7) per user a month, billed annually, based on a 200-person company. Academy has no listed price. Existing WorkRamp customers should expect the Confirm name on contracts and help-centre pages; the help centre now publishes release notes under the Learn:Up and Academy names.

This profile is put together from the company's own pages and published reporting, checked on 15 October 2026. We have not tested the product, and nothing here is paid placement.

faq.a: The product does, under new names. Learning Pool bought WorkRamp in October 2025, then rebranded as Confirm in August 2026; WorkRamp's products are now Learn:Up and Academy.
Confirm lists Learn:Up from $9 per user a month, billed annually, based on a 200-person company.
The acquisition announcement named Canva, Sprout Social, Reddit and Box as customers.
